title: Sweat test
what: A little sweating is triggered on the skin of the arm, and the sweat is collected. The salt in it is measured. This helps check for cystic fibrosis.
why: If newborn screening showed a risk of cystic fibrosis, or for frequent bronchitis and pneumonia, poor weight gain, or greasy stools.
duration: usually 30 to 60 minutes; results often come the same day
tell_doctor: If your child has eczema or irritated skin on the arms
If your child takes steroids or water pills
If your child is ill or has a fever now
Your baby's weight and age in weeks

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually no special prep. Feed your child as usual.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: On the test day, do not put creams or oils on the arms.

prepare.title: Health
prepare.text: If your child is ill now, ask if the test should be moved.

prepare.title: Kids
prepare.text: Bring a toy, a book, or cartoons. Your child needs to sit for about half an hour.

bring: The newborn screening report, if you have it
steps: The skin on the forearm is washed and dried
Two small electrodes with gel are placed, and a weak current runs for about 5 minutes
The electrodes are removed, and a sweat collector is attached to the spot
Your child sits quietly for about 30 minutes with the arm covered
The collector is removed and sent to the lab
feel: Light tingling or warmth under the electrodes
It does not hurt, but waiting can be boring for a child
Afterward, the skin may be a little red
after: The redness goes away in a few hours
Results often come the same day or in 1 to 2 days
Sometimes the test is repeated if too little sweat was collected

faq.q: Is the current safe for my child?
faq.a: Yes. The current is very weak. It only helps the skin make sweat.

faq.q: What if the result is borderline?
faq.a: The doctor may order a repeat test or a genetic test.

reminders.text: Sweat test tomorrow. Do not put cream on your child's arms, and bring a toy for the half-hour wait.
